previewText: Put the Yard Tools Away the Right Way, Loganville's Autumnfest on Saturday, October 17, and a quick Gwinnett and Jackson market check.

paragraphs: A new month is underway, and October has a way of filling up fast. This week's homeowner tip is cleaning and storing yard tools for the season, and it only takes a few minutes.
And if you want a reason to get out and about, Loganville's Autumnfest is coming up on Saturday, October 17. As always, I am glad you are here.

market.title: Gwinnett and Jackson County: September 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: In September 2026, Realtor.com counted 3,833 active listings in Gwinnett County, 14.3% more listings than a year earlier. The median listing price was $449,945.
Homes in Jackson County spent a median of 72 days on the market in September 2026, 14.3% longer than a year earlier. About 20% of active listings had a price reduction.
The simple version for Gwinnett and Jackson County: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data, September 2026 (latest monthly release). Figures are countywide listing data, not closed sales.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Put the Yard Tools Away the Right Way
rotatingFeatures.topic: cleaning and storing yard tools for the season
paragraphs: Once the fall yard work is done, UGA Extension's home checklist suggests emptying and cleaning gas cans and cleaning and storing garden tools.
items: Knock dried dirt off shovels, rakes, and pruners.
Dry metal tools before storing them so they do not rust.
Store gas cans and fuel equipment away from living spaces, following the manufacturer's directions.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Clean tools in the fall make for an easier start in spring.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist (C1082).

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Loganville Autumnfest
paragraphs: Loganville's Autumnfest takes over Main Street on the third Saturday in October, with more than 175 food, arts, and crafts vendors.
The city lists live music, local performances, and a Kids Zone with activities for children.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Main Street, downtown Loganville. Check the city's events page for parking and any schedule changes.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: City of Loganville community events page.
